keyframes_css: @keyframes cue { 0% { transform: scaleY(0); } 45% { transform: scaleY(1); transform-origin: top; } 46% { transform-origin: bottom; } 100% { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; } }

@keyframes grain { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 20% { transform: translate(-3%, 2%); } 40% { transform: translate(2%, -3%); } 60% { transform: translate(-2%, -2%); } 80% { transform: translate(3%, 3%); } 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); } }
@keyframes ritVapor { 0% { transform: translateY(10%) scale(0.9); opacity: 0; } 45% { opacity: 0.85; } 100% { transform: translateY(-120%) scale(1.3); opacity: 0; } }
